simple.meaning: the trunk or stump of a tree (as felled or as planted)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גֶּזַע (H1503) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גֶּזַע (gezaʻ) means the trunk or stump of a tree (as felled or as planted) First listed occurrence: Isa 11 1.

definitions.short: the trunk or stump of a tree (as felled or as planted)
definitions.full: H1503. geza [ גֶּ֫זַע ] noun masculine Job 14:8 stock, stem (Late Hebrew id. , compare Syriac stem, trunk ) — construct גֶּזַע Isa 11:1 ; suffix גִּזְעוֺ Job 14:8 , גִּזְעָם Isa 40:24 ; — stock, stem of a tree Job 14:8 (|| שֹׁרֶשׁ ); figurative ׳ג ישׁי ' stem of Jesse Isa 11:1 (|| שֹׁרֶשׁ ); ג בָּאָרֶץ ׳שֹׁרֵשׁ 40:24 (|| זרע נטע, ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to cut down (trees);
